evidence: Has the Validation label and modifies UTXO snapshot loading logic in src/validation.cpp and src/node/utxo_snapshot.h.
rationale: Fixes edge cases in assumeutxo snapshot validation that permit inflated coin counts and interrupt check bypasses. As described, snapshots with duplicated records 'collapse into one coin' and 'still match the committed UTXO hash' while reporting inflated counts in `loadtxoutset`, and empty transaction groups 'bypass the interrupt check and can delay shutdown.'
